completion_data.completion_summary: Introduced a single canonical normalize_topic() helper (lowercase kebab-case) and routed it through manage-topics.sh (write) and both generate-task-order.sh renderers (.claude core + .opencode, read/grouping), fixing the origin case-mismatch bug, preventing duplicate case/separator headings, adding an autonomous-context directive, and documenting the topic/active_topics schema fields. Verified zero migration needed for this repo's existing topic data.

memory_candidates.content: When a bug report names a specific case-sensitivity symptom (e.g. a grouped-render tree collapses flat for non-lowercase keys), the durable fix is often ONE normalization helper applied at BOTH the write chokepoint and every read/comparison guard, rather than patching each buggy comparison independently ad hoc (e.g. scattered ${var,,} lowercasing). Routing the grouping key and both comparison operands through the same canonical-form function makes inequality tests correct without special-casing and simultaneously fixes latent separator-variant duplicate-heading bugs. When the same logic must exist in multiple deployment trees that cannot share a sourced library (e.g. a core-extension source, its deployed mirror, and a separate tool's tree), embed a byte-identical, clearly-labeled 'keep in sync' copy in each rather than trying to force a cross-tree include.

For fixture-based bash script testing that must never touch a real state file, copying just the script(s) plus a state-file copy into a scratch directory that mirrors the real relative path layout (so the script's own SCRIPT_DIR/PROJECT_ROOT resolution naturally targets the fixture) avoids needing any env-var override support in the script itself.
